speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Apart from the review, there is already an Early Childhood Skills Framework and a Continuing Professional Development (CPD) roadmap.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: ECDA is also paying attention to educators’ well-being.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The ongoing digitalisation initiatives help educators’ better manage their workload.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: ECDA will continue to engage and work closely with our stakeholders and pursue improvements in these areas.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: I am pretty sure the last two and a half years have been difficult for them, especially with our children and the COVID-19 situation.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Thanks also for sharing a bit on the mental health well-being plans the Ministry has.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Could the Minister expand a bit more on the points that he raised earlier on digitalisation and how we can better support them in those terms?

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: They have also actually shared a bit on some ergonomic issues, for example, because they are sitting on really low seats and the tables are all smaller.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Could we look into expanding this framework and see how we can provide ergonomically better or special equipment for all teachers as they teach, too?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I remember when I was in Primary school and all the way to Secondary school, my teachers used to collect fees in cash every month and then issue receipts one by one to all of us.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I am not surprised that we have been doing this for a very long time.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: And we do need to help our teachers perform these administrative functions, whether they are doing fee collection, temperature-taking during COVID-19, for example, and, now, as it continues to be important; keeping in touch with parents; marking attendance.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We also take inputs from preschool leaders when there are new things that they want to do.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: For example, I saw applications that use e-learning that they transfer from book-type of recording into digital devices so that they can be reused again and again.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Of course, it is also a very good sustainable effort.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: So, all these things are being done and will evolve.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Actually, I am very happy to see, as I visit some preschools, that we are at the leading edge not only to digitalise for the purpose of education but also to help them with their productivity.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Of course, as I mentioned just now, we are always concerned for their physical and mental well-being, including their work environment.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Some of the recommendations, as the Member mentioned just now, were to ensure that they have proper seats to sit on.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Our teachers are very dedicated and they really connect with our children.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: They want to sit on the floor and, sometimes, on low stools so that they could connect at eye level with their children.

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Can I ask the Minister how the EC educators' pay scale compares with that of the teachers now?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: So, this is the balancing that we have to make across them and to compare.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Whether it is a good thing to compare between preschool and school teachers is a question that professionals can help us to answer.
